claims.assertion: Yazhi says Taygetans make toys from durable, moldable non-hydrocarbon resin; children often build them by hand or design and replicate them at home.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says toy preferences vary and there are no gender-role restrictions.

claims.assertion: Raguel describes a cooperative Taygetan building-design board game requiring memory, spatial planning, and usually telepathic sharing of detailed mental images.
claims.speaker: Raguel
claims.qualifiers: She says spoken descriptions can substitute for telepathy.
